LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: ESSAY WRITING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Writing 3.6 Guided writing: Poetry (2 Sessions) Simple poems Descriptive words B
Topic 3.8: Guided Writing: Essay Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing: Essay Writing, part of Writing 3.6 Guided writing: Poetry (2 Sessions) Simple poems Descriptive words B in Grade 8 ARABIC.

Key inquiry question: What tips can you use to develop neat handwriting?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify vocabulary related to the theme for comprehension,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Guided Writing: Essay Writing in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. write a simple essay using acquired vocabulary and expressions,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Guided Writing: Essay Writing in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. appreciate the skill of writing for effective communication.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Guided Writing: Essay Writing in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. identify vocabulary related to the theme for comprehension,

   Guided Writing: Essay Writing helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. write a simple essay using acquired vocabulary and expressions,

   Guided Writing: Essay Writing helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. appreciate the skill of writing for effective communication.

   Guided Writing: Essay Writing helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. collaboratively make a list of vocabulary related to eather and environment,

2. organise the vocabulary in a portfolio for future reference,

3. work with peers to identify meaning of new words,

4. fill gaps to complete simple sentences with suitable words related to physical features,

5. collaborate with peers to write a neat and coherent essay related to the theme,

6. share their essays with peers for review.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. collaboratively make a list of vocabulary related to eather and environment,
2. organise the vocabulary in a portfolio for future reference,
3. work with peers to identify meaning of new words,
4. fill gaps to complete simple sentences with suitable words related to physical features,
5. collaborate with peers to write a neat and coherent essay related to the theme,
6. share their essays with peers for review.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing: Essay Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination: These are promoted as the learner exchanges new ideas that inspire creativity when writing a

neat and coherent essay related to the theme.

• Learning to learn: This is promoted as the learner builds on their own learning experiences by sharing their essays with peers

for review.

Responsibility: This is promoted as the learner diligently organises the words in a portfolio for future reference.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:

environment.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of vocabulary building to their learning of similar concepts in English and Kiswahili.
